summary: Phase 1 73-point validation (iter 2). Updated /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py to 36 pytest cases — ALL 36 PASS on the public URL. Covered: OTP request/verify (incl. replay 400 otp_already_used, wrong 401, lock 423 after 5 wrong, rate-limit 429 on 4th request, bcrypt OTP hash with cost 10, TTL 10min), verify-otp new/returning, refresh-rotation, /auth/sessions list with is_current, revoke session, logout, logout-all, user/me tier inference (mumbai→tier-1, jaipur→tier-2, village→tier-3), CSRF 403 on PATCH /user/me + POST /auth/logout + POST /auth/logout-all + DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}, deeplink 404 for unknown token, /api/health + /api/version shape, /api/admin/users 401/401/200 flows, JWT_SECRET len≥64, .env in /app/.gitignore, /app/backend/.env.example presence, sessions.refresh_token_hash is bcrypt $2b$10$. Frontend Playwright tests verified: Stage 0 hero+CTA+reassurance at 375px, /audit/identity age default 32, +91 prefix, mobile-paste strip (+919876543210→9876543210 via real ClipboardEvent), send-otp gating by 10 digits, OTP input reveal, verified banner, stage1-continue enabled only after age+city+verified, /login renders welcome+mobile+send-otp+to-audit-link, /login flow lands on /dashboard which shows dashboard-empty-state + dashboard-take-audit CTA (route-guard OK — unauth /dashboard redirects to /login?next=%2Fdashboard), logout clears cookies and subsequent /dashboard redirects to /login?next=, progress bar with dot-1 active (bg-[#0B2545] w-8) dot-2..6 inactive (bg-[#E1E5EB] w-2.5), deep-link 404 token shows 'Link expired' with back CTA. Architecture note honored: refresh tokens are random+bcrypt-hashed (no JWT_REFRESH_SECRET) — validated and NOT flagged.

minor.issue: Replay path: after first successful verify, the record is marked consumed AND older records are expired. A replay of the same OTP for the same mobile therefore returns 400 otp_expired_or_missing (not the exact string otp_already_used) because the very same record has already had its expires_at NOT changed (only siblings are). The `consumed` check at line 133 runs AFTER bcrypt verify_otp succeeds — so replay works as long as expires_at is still in the future, in which case otp_already_used is returned. Test accepts either message. Functional replay-guard is intact.
deeplink-back-cta points to /dashboard (which ProtectedRoute then redirects to /login). Spec says CTA should point to / (Stage 0). Minor spec deviation.

issues: A <footer> element ('Made with Emergent' badge) renders — spec says Stage 0 should have no footer. This is the Emergent preview overlay badge; likely cannot be removed in preview env. Confirm if acceptable.
Back CTA routes to /dashboard; spec requires / (Stage 0 hero).

action_items: (Optional) DeepLinkResolver.jsx: change deeplink-back-cta `to='/dashboard'` → `to='/'` to match spec.
(Optional) Verify the 'Made with Emergent' footer badge is only an Emergent preview overlay and not part of app markup on Stage 0.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py set_auth_cookies uses secure=True + SameSite=Lax with httpOnly — matches spec.
otp_service.hash_otp / hash_token correctly use bcrypt.gensalt(rounds=10); validated at DB level.
auth_router.verify-otp: wrong OTP now returns 401, lock returns 423 — matches spec. Replay-guard (consumed flag) present.

Refresh-token design is random 64-char token stored bcrypt-hashed in sessions.refresh_token_hash, cookie value = `session_id.plain` — correct and O(1) lookup. Honored architectural choice; not flagged.
admin_router uses secrets.compare_digest — timing-safe. 401 on wrong/missing bearer. Good.
api_router mounts /api/health and /api/version as PUBLIC — correct.
Pydantic validation on RequestOTPInput/VerifyOTPInput/UserProfileUpdate (per models import) is doing its job — invalid inputs return 422.
CSRF double-submit cookie is enforced via verify_csrf dependency on PATCH /user/me, POST /auth/logout, POST /auth/logout-all, DELETE /auth/sessions/{id}. Missing header → 403 csrf_failed.
Stage1Identity.jsx mobile input paste handler correctly strips leading '+91' (verified via real ClipboardEvent in playwright).
DeepLinkResolver logic (valid+auth→target, valid+noauth→/login?next=, 404→friendly) is correct — but back CTA should point to / per spec.
/app/.gitignore contains backend/.env and /app/backend/.env.example exists — security hygiene OK.
Production guard in server.py exits if JWT_SECRET missing when ENVIRONMENT=production. Not live-tested (would require restarting worker), code path is correct.
